items.title: A Lonely Creature Dreams of Friendship

sentences.en: The speaker is the creature created by Victor Frankenstein, and he is telling his own story in this passage.
sentences.zh: 这段话的讲述者是由维克多·弗兰肯斯坦创造的生物，他正在讲述自己的故事。

sentences.en: He lives secretly near a small cottage, where he watches a poor family every day.
sentences.zh: 他偷偷住在一间小屋附近，每天观察一个贫穷的家庭。

sentences.en: The family includes an old blind father, a gentle young woman named Agatha, and her brother Felix.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭有一位年迈的盲人父亲、一位温柔的年轻女子阿加莎，以及她的兄弟费利克斯。

sentences.en: The creature notices that Felix looks miserable and that Agatha often seems sad for reasons he does not know.
sentences.zh: 这个生物注意到费利克斯看起来很痛苦，而阿加莎也常常显得悲伤，但他不知道原因。

sentences.en: He becomes very curious about their lives and wants to understand why they suffer so much.
sentences.zh: 他对他们的生活产生强烈好奇，想要理解他们为什么如此受苦。

sentences.en: Because he has learned to care about them, he dreams of restoring happiness to these deserving people.
sentences.zh: 因为他已经学会关心他们，他梦想着让这些值得幸福的人重获快乐。

sentences.en: He imagines that the blind father, Agatha, and Felix could become the judges of his future destiny.
sentences.zh: 他想象那位盲人父亲、阿加莎和费利克斯可能成为决定他未来命运的人。

sentences.en: In his mind, he pictures many different scenes of introducing himself to the family and waiting for their reaction.
sentences.zh: 在他的脑海中，他设想许多不同的场景：向这家人介绍自己，并等待他们的反应。

sentences.en: At first, he fears that they will be disgusted by his strange appearance and will reject him completely.
sentences.zh: 起初，他害怕他们会厌恶他奇怪的外表，并彻底拒绝他。

sentences.en: He hopes that gentle behavior and kind, calming words will first win their trust and later their love.
sentences.zh: 他希望温和的举止和友善、安抚的话语能先赢得他们的信任，之后赢得他们的爱。

sentences.en: However, he has not yet met them, so these hopeful scenes remain only inside his imagination.
sentences.zh: 然而，他还没有与他们见面，所以这些充满希望的情景只存在于他的想象中。

sentences.en: The passage shows his deep loneliness and his strong wish to belong somewhere and be accepted.
sentences.zh: 这段文字展现了他深深的孤独，以及他渴望在某处有所归属并被接纳的强烈愿望。

items.attribution: Lewis Carroll · Alice's Adventures in Wonderland · Project Gutenberg
items.title: Alice and the Round Mushroom in Wonderland
items.titleZh: 爱丽丝与仙境中的圆蘑菇

sentences.en: Alice is a curious young girl who falls down a rabbit hole and enters a strange magical world called Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝是一个好奇的小女孩，她掉进兔子洞，进入了一个叫仙境的奇特魔法世界。

sentences.en: In Wonderland, she meets unusual creatures and faces many puzzling situations that test her courage and quick thinking.
sentences.zh: 在仙境里，她遇到不寻常的生物，面对许多考验她勇气和快速思考的困惑处境。

sentences.en: At one point in the story, she finds a special round mushroom that can make her grow taller or become smaller.
sentences.zh: 故事中的某个时刻，她发现一朵特别的圆蘑菇，能让她长高或变小。

sentences.en: She has learned that one side of the mushroom makes her grow, while the other side has the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 她得知蘑菇的一边会让她长大，而另一边则有相反的效果。

sentences.en: However, the mushroom is perfectly round, so it is not clear which side is which.
sentences.zh: 然而，蘑菇完全是圆的，所以很难看清哪一边是哪一边。

sentences.en: Alice looks at the mushroom thoughtfully for a minute and tries to understand its two different sides.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝若有所思地看了蘑菇一分钟，试图弄清它两个不同的边。

sentences.en: This is a difficult question for her because the mushroom has no obvious marks or edges to guide her.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说是个难题，因为蘑菇上没有明显的标记或边缘可以指引她。

sentences.en: She needs two pieces, one from each side, so that she can test their different powers later.
sentences.zh: 她需要两块，每边一块，以便之后测试它们不同的功效。

sentences.en: At last, Alice stretches her arms around the mushroom as far as they will go.
sentences.zh: 最后，爱丽丝尽可能把双臂环抱在蘑菇周围。

sentences.en: Then she breaks off a small piece from the edge with each hand.
sentences.zh: 然后，她用每只手从边缘掰下一小块。

sentences.en: She succeeds in getting two pieces, even though she cannot decide which side is which.
sentences.zh: 她成功得到了两块，尽管她无法判断哪一边是哪一边。

sentences.en: With these two pieces, she can later test the mushroom's effects and continue her journey through Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 有了这两块，她之后可以测试蘑菇的效果，并继续她在仙境的旅程。

items.attribution: Jane Austen · Pride and Prejudice · Project Gutenberg
items.title: Frequent Visits and a Controlling Lady
items.titleZh: 频繁的拜访与一位控制欲强的贵妇

sentences.en: This passage comes from Pride and Prejudice, a famous novel by Jane Austen about love, class, and social manners.
sentences.zh: 这段选文出自《傲慢与偏见》，这是简·奥斯汀的一部名著，探讨爱情、阶级和社会礼仪。

sentences.en: Mr. Collins is a clergyman who lives near Rosings, the large and impressive home of Lady Catherine de Bourgh.
sentences.zh: 柯林斯先生是一位牧师，住在罗新斯附近；罗新斯是凯瑟琳·德·包尔夫人宏伟气派的宅邸。

sentences.en: Lady Catherine is a rich and powerful noblewoman, so Mr. Collins respects her greatly and tries hard to please her.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳夫人是一位有钱有势的贵妇，因此柯林斯先生非常尊敬她，并努力取悦她。

sentences.en: His wife, Charlotte, is Elizabeth Bennet's close friend, and Elizabeth is currently staying at their home.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子夏洛特是伊丽莎白·班纳特的密友，伊丽莎白目前住在他们家里。

sentences.en: Mr. Collins walks to Rosings almost every day, and Charlotte often goes with him because she thinks these visits are necessary.
sentences.zh: 柯林斯先生几乎每天都步行去罗新斯，夏洛特也常和他一起去，因为她认为这些拜访很有必要。

sentences.en: At first, Elizabeth cannot understand why they are willing to spend so many hours on these repeated visits.
sentences.zh: 起初，伊丽莎白不明白他们为什么愿意在这些反复的拜访上花这么多时间。

sentences.en: Sometimes Lady Catherine calls at their home, and during these visits she carefully observes everything happening in the room.
sentences.zh: 有时凯瑟琳夫人会到他们家拜访；在这些拜访中，她仔细地观察房间里发生的一切。

sentences.en: She asks about their daily work, examines their sewing, and often advises them to do things in a different way.
sentences.zh: 她询问他们的日常工作，查看他们的缝纫活，还常常建议他们换一种方式做事。

sentences.en: She also finds fault with the arrangement of the furniture and looks for signs of carelessness in the housemaid.
sentences.zh: 她还挑剔家具的摆放，并寻找女佣粗心大意的迹象。

sentences.en: If she accepts any food or drink, she seems to do so mainly to find something to criticize.
sentences.zh: 如果她接受食物或饮料，她似乎主要是为了找点东西来批评。

sentences.en: For example, she notices that Mrs. Collins's joints of meat are too large for such a small family.
sentences.zh: 例如，她注意到柯林斯太太家的大块肉对于这么小的家庭来说太大了。

sentences.en: Through these details, Elizabeth sees Lady Catherine's pride and controlling manner, and she begins to understand life at Rosings.
sentences.zh: 通过这些细节，伊丽莎白看到了凯瑟琳夫人的傲慢和控制欲，也开始理解罗新斯的生活。

glossary.zh: 宏伟的；令人印象深刻的

items.attribution: Robert Louis Stevenson · Treasure Island · Project Gutenberg
items.title: Adrift Beside the Hispaniola
items.titleZh: 在伊斯帕尼奥拉号旁漂流

sentences.en: Jim Hawkins is a young sailor travelling on the Hispaniola during a dangerous search for hidden treasure.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·霍金斯是一名年轻水手，正乘着“伊斯帕尼奥拉号”进行一次危险的寻宝航行。

sentences.en: One dark night, he suddenly finds himself alone in the cold sea beside the moving ship.
sentences.zh: 一个漆黑的夜晚，他突然发现自己独自一人在冰冷的海水中，旁边是正在移动的船。

sentences.en: When he opens his eyes, small waves are moving all around him and breaking softly.
sentences.zh: 他睁开眼睛时，小小的波浪在他四周涌动，轻轻破碎。

sentences.en: They make a sharp, hissing sound and shine faintly in the darkness as they rise and fall.
sentences.zh: 波浪起伏时发出尖锐的嘶嘶声，并在黑暗中微微发亮。

sentences.en: The Hispaniola is only a few yards away, and the large ship is still moving through the night water.
sentences.zh: “伊斯帕尼奥拉号”就在几码之外，这艘大船仍在夜色中的水面上前行。

sentences.en: Jim is caught in the ship's wake, so he is being pulled along behind it by the moving water.
sentences.zh: 吉姆被困在船的尾流中，因此被流动的海水拖在船后前行。

sentences.en: He watches the ship's long poles move slightly against the black night sky above him.
sentences.zh: 他望着船上的长杆在头顶漆黑的夜空背景下微微晃动。

sentences.en: After looking for a while, he becomes sure that the ship is slowly turning toward the south.
sentences.zh: 看了一会儿后，他确信船正在慢慢转向南方。

sentences.en: This turn is important because the ship may soon move farther away and leave him behind.
sentences.zh: 这个转向很重要，因为船可能很快就会驶得更远，把他抛在后面。

sentences.en: Although he is frightened, Jim knows that he must stay calm and keep himself above the water.
sentences.zh: 尽管很害怕，吉姆知道自己必须保持冷静，并让自己保持在水面之上。

sentences.en: He looks around carefully and tries to think of a practical way to survive and return to safety.
sentences.zh: 他仔细环顾四周，努力想出一个可行的办法来活下来并回到安全之处。

sentences.en: The dark sea, the cold water, and the moving ship make this a night he will never forget.
sentences.zh: 黑暗的大海、冰冷的海水和移动的船，使这一夜成为他永远难忘的夜晚。

items.attribution: H. G. Wells · The Time Machine · Project Gutenberg
items.title: The Time Machine（选段）

sentences.en: “This adjustment, I say, must have been done, and done well; done indeed for all Time, in the space of Time across which my machine had leapt.
The air was free from gnats, the earth from weeds or fungi; everywhere were fruits and sweet and delightful flowers; brilliant butterflies flew hither and thither.
The ideal of preventive medicine was attained.
Diseases had been stamped out.
I saw no evidence of any contagious diseases during all my stay.
And I shall have to tell you later that even the processes of putrefaction and decay had been profoundly affected by these changes.
During a dangerous and confusing period, a wise man asked a close friend to put complete trust in him.
sentences.zh: 在一个危险而令人困惑的时期，一位智者请一位密友完全信任他。

sentences.en: His recent actions had seemed violent and strange, so the friend struggled to understand why he had acted that way.
sentences.zh: 他最近的行为看似暴烈而古怪，因此这位朋友很难理解他为何那样做。

sentences.en: The man knew that trusting such strong actions is very hard when the reasons are still hidden.
sentences.zh: 这个人明白，当原因仍被隐藏时，信任如此激烈的行为非常困难。

sentences.en: He openly accepted that his friend did not trust him fully yet, because true understanding had not arrived.
sentences.zh: 他坦率地承认，朋友还没有完全信任他，因为真正的理解尚未到来。

sentences.en: He then warned that more difficult moments might come in the future, perhaps sooner than either of them expected.
sentences.zh: 随后他警告说，未来可能会有更多艰难时刻，也许比两人预料的更早到来。

sentences.en: In those moments, he might again ask for trust while he could not, or must not, explain his plan.
sentences.zh: 在那些时刻，他可能再次请求信任，却无法或不被允许解释自己的计划。

sentences.en: His friend might feel unable or even unwilling to give that trust at the time.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友当时可能感到无法，甚至不愿意给予那种信任。

sentences.en: Even so, he gave a serious promise that complete trust would one day replace doubt and fear.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，他郑重承诺，完全的信任终有一天会取代怀疑与恐惧。

sentences.en: When that day finally came, his friend would understand everything as clearly as sunlight.
sentences.zh: 当那一天终于到来时，他的朋友会像阳光照耀般清楚地理解一切。

sentences.en: Then his friend would bless him for his own sake, for other people, and for a dear lady.
sentences.zh: 那时，他的朋友会为了他自己、为了他人、也为了那位亲爱的女士而感激他。

sentences.en: He had sworn to protect that lady, and this promise stood behind all his strange actions.
sentences.zh: 他曾发誓保护那位女士，而这个承诺支撑着他所有古怪的行为。

sentences.en: In the end, the message was simple: trust may come before understanding, but understanding will come.
sentences.zh: 最终，信息很简单：信任可能先于理解到来，但理解终会到来。
